[[Category:function space]]
An '''eigenfunction''' is [[eigenvector and eigenvalue|an eigenvector]] in a [[function space]].

== Formal definition ==

Let $V\in \mathbb{F}^X$ be a [[function space]], $\hat A$ be an [[operator]] there.

Then if for $f \in V$

$$
\hat Af=\lambda f,
$$

then $f$ is an '''eigenfunction''' of [[operator]] $\hat A$, associated with '''eigenvalue''' $\lambda$.
